title: Turn submission 0.1
description: Request body for POST /v1/case-executions/{case_execution_id}/turn. Redbeak persists the submission exactly once, keyed by `idempotency_key`; resubmitting the same key returns the original next action without creating a duplicate event.

observations.description: Facts observed for this turn. Empty when the assignment requested none. Outcome observations may be collected after every turn to preserve temporal evidence.
